messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Financial Transactions" as it appears in the following examples.
['You have an incoming payment selected for your account.', "The charge for this order will appear on your credit card statement from the merchant 'AMZN Payment Services.'", 'We advise you to log in to your internet banking account using the link below to notify us if you made this money transfer from your account, failure to do so may result to illegal withdrawal from your internet banking account.', 'Make payments or send money.', 'This e-mail has been sent to you by BT Internet to inform you that we were unable to process your most recent payment of bill.', 'For financial contributions, please contact, ACCOUNTANT NAME: MR KINGSLEY PHILIPPIANS NAME: MAYAN BEHARDACCOUNT NUMBER: 114094031608SWIFT CODE : MBBEMYKLADDRESS: 14290 ISMS SOME DARBY, WILMA SOME DARBY, KUALA LUMPUR MALAYSIA in case of Western Union, please do send to, Mr David love, Malaysia.', 'We have decided to give you 20%of the fund for your involvement, 10% will be for expenses and 70%is for my colleagues and me,', 'After this period, the required sum will be taken from your default payment option and the signup will be activated.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
